parsed.note_claim: VAR can review yellow cards issued due to mistaken identity, as happened earlier in this World Cup during USA vs Paraguay when Tim Ream's booking was overturned and given to Miguel Almirón for simulation.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Makkelie eventually overturned the yellow on Ream, instead booking Almirón for simulation, justifying the "mistaken identity" definition.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly confirms the VAR review overturned Tim Ream's yellow card and issued it to Miguel Almirón for simulation during the USA vs Paraguay match.
